g.text: 1) Frequent driver location Update & proximity search on location data:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: assuming 10M drivers sending location every 5 sec is around 2M wps. which

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Bad Solution: direct db writes + proximity queries

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Good Solution: batch processing + geospatial databse for geospatial

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Using redis inmemory data store to handle real time location update

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: requests. It provides geohashing for proximity search as well.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - we can further optimize this by using adaptive location update intervals.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: i.e dynamically adjusting the freq of location updates based on contextual

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: factors like spee, direction, distance etc.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) Preventing multiple ride requests to same driver:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - good solution: request sent to driver and driver status marked as

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: outstanding_request. If the driver accepts the request, we update the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: status to "accepted" and if they deny it, we update the status to

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: "available". We can then use a simple timeout mechanism within the Ride

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Service to ensure that the lock is released if the driver does not respond

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - great Solution: Using distributed lock with ttl When a ride request is sent

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: to a driver, a lock is created with a unique identifier (e.g., driverId) and a

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: TTL set to the acceptance window duration of 10 seconds. The Ride

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Matching Service attempts to acquire a lock on the driverId in Redis. If

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the lock is successfully acquired, it means no other service instance can

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: send a ride request to the same driver until the lock expires or is released.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: If the driver accepts the ride within the TTL window, the Ride Matching

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Service updates the ride status to "accepted" in the database, and the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: lock is released in Redis. If the driver does not accept the ride within the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: TTL window, the lock in Redis expires automatically. This expiration allows

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the Ride Matching Service to consider the driver for new ride requests

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) Ensuring no ride requests are dropped during peak demand periods; we

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: introduce a queue with dynamic scaling.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: further scaling can be done with geosharding and read replicas.
